definitions.explanation: Used to emphasize degree, often with adjectives describing normalcy or simplicity. Has a somewhat formal or literary tone.

examples.japanese: {至|いた}って{健康|けんこう}です。
{彼|かれ}は{至|いた}って{真面目|まじめ}な{人|ひと}だ。
examples.english: He is an extremely serious person.

examples.japanese: {作業|さぎょう}は{至|いた}って{順調|じゅんちょう}に{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: The work is progressing extremely smoothly.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {至|いた}って{健康|けんこう}: perfectly healthy
- {至|いた}って{普通|ふつう}: completely normal
- {至|いた}って{簡単|かんたん}: extremely simple
